title: Drone-Based Daylight Electroluminescence Imaging of PV Modules
mechanism: Drone camera at 120 fps captures EL and background frame pairs under modulated bias in full daylight, giving module EL images.
evidence: R: diagnostic EL images from about 1 s of capture near 1 sun; SNR_avg 4.6.
adaptation: Moonshot route to field EL for WattCycle; our EL model would face a resolution and SNR shift like E1. Cheap proxy now: degrade test cells to drone-EL resolution and noise and measure the drop.
min_experiment: Degrade test clean-49 cells (downsample to 32 to 128 px per cell, add noise to SNR 4.6, upsample), score the house ensemble; report crack relF1@2 and inactive IoU per level. Decision aid for WattCycle hardware, no model change.
prior_overlap: Desk study ruled out drone EL by camera cost (SWIR); no measurement of required resolution was made.
